subject: Re: Kickoff: DIPPER red-teaming for the provenance features
body:
Attack results, on time for June 12.

Headline: our detection stack fares little better than the published baselines. Under DIPPER paraphrase at moderate knob settings (lex=60, order=60), our watermark detector drops from 81% to 11% detection at 1% FPR, and the classifier-based detector to 9%. Turning reordering up further buys the attacker little extra -- lexical diversity does most of the damage. Semantics hold up: human spot-checks confirm the paraphrases preserve meaning, which is what makes this attack realistic.

The harness made the sweep painless -- 40 attack configurations, 3 domains, fully reproducible. Credit to Giannis and Katya.

Risk for phase two: the retrieval defense's strength depends on the candidate text staying semantically close to a stored generation. Multi-round paraphrase might walk far enough away. Adding a multi-round attack arm to the July evaluation.

Wei
